title: Step 5b - Visualizing K-Means Clusters: Plotting Customer Segments in Python

cues.en: -: All right, perfect.
cues.zh: 講師：好，很好。

cues.en: So now, let's do the same for the other clusters.
cues.zh: 現在對其他群組做同樣的事。

cues.en: So I'm going to actually copy this line of code and we're gonna paste it right below to plot the second cluster and then the third one, the fourth one, and the fifth one.
cues.zh: 我複製這行程式碼，貼到下面畫第二群，再來第三群、第四群、第五群。

cues.en: All right, so according to you, now, what do we have to change in this second row in order to plot the second cluster?
cues.zh: 你覺得第二行要改什麼，才能畫出第二群？

cues.en: Well, if you understood how we plotted that first cluster, then you should have absolutely no issue to figure out how to plot this second cluster.
cues.zh: 如果你了解第一群的畫法，要想出第二群怎麼畫，就應該完全沒有問題。

cues.en: Of course, what we only need to change here in the coordinates is that value of y_kmeans, which this time is not equal to zero,
cues.zh: 當然，座標這裡唯一要改的就是 y_kmeans 的值；這次不等於 0，

cues.en: but should be equal to the value of cluster number two, which has index one, right?
cues.zh: 而應該等於第二群的值，也就是索引 1，對吧？

cues.en: Because indexes in Python start from zero.
cues.zh: 因為 Python 的索引從 0 開始。

cues.en: And same here, same for the Y coordinate.
cues.zh: 這裡也一樣，Y 座標也是。

cues.en: And then all the rest is the same.
cues.zh: 其餘都相同。

cues.en: This selects the X coordinate.
cues.zh: 這裡選 X 座標。

cues.en: This selects the Y coordinate.
cues.zh: 這裡選 Y 座標。

cues.en: Then we choose the same size.
cues.zh: 然後選相同的大小。

cues.en: Then of course, we're gonna choose a different color.
cues.zh: 當然要選不同的顏色。

cues.en: We're gonna choose this time blue and then the label will be this time cluster two.
cues.zh: 這次選藍色，標籤改成 Cluster 2。

cues.en: All right, very simply.
cues.zh: 好，很簡單。

cues.en: Now, let's do the same for the third cluster.
cues.zh: 第三群也一樣。

cues.en: This time y_kmeans will be equal to two. Same here.
cues.zh: 這次 y_kmeans 等於 2，這裡也一樣。

cues.en: Then we choose the same size, a new color, which will be this time, well, green, and the label will be cluster three.
cues.zh: 再選相同大小、新顏色，這次是綠色，標籤是 Cluster 3。

cues.en: Okay, let's plot that again.
cues.zh: 好，再畫一次。

cues.en: Y_kmeans will be equal this time to three.
cues.zh: 這次 y_kmeans 等於 3。

cues.en: That's for cluster number four.
cues.zh: 這是第四群。

cues.en: Then here, same, y_kmeans equal three, same size, different color, which will be this time, we must start to become an artist here, so let's see, cyan.
cues.zh: 這裡也一樣，y_kmeans 等於 3、相同大小，再換個顏色；我們得開始發揮藝術感了，來選青色。

cues.en: You know this color. It's pretty nice.
cues.zh: 你知道這個顏色，挺漂亮的。

cues.en: Cluster this time four.
cues.zh: 這次是 Cluster 4。

cues.en: And finally, last cluster.
cues.zh: 最後一個群組。

cues.en: This time we wanna select all the customers belonging to cluster number five, for which all the y_kmeans value are equal to four, right?
cues.zh: 這次要選取所有屬於第五群的顧客，他們的 y_kmeans 值全都等於 4，對吧？

cues.en: So here we're placing, again, three by four, and same size, new color, which we will choose to be magenta.
cues.zh: 所以再次把 3 換成 4，大小相同，再換個新顏色，就選洋紅色。

cues.en: And finally, label cluster number five.
cues.zh: 最後，標籤是 Cluster 5。

cues.en: And congratulations, we just plotted our five clusters but we're gonna do even better.
cues.zh: 恭喜，剛剛畫出了五個群組，但我們還要做得更好。

cues.en: We're now gonna plot the centroids of each of these clusters and to do this, we will use, once again, the scatter function inside which, well that's the same,
cues.zh: 現在畫出每個群組的質心；一樣使用 scatter 函式，裡面也一樣，

cues.en: we have to input the different coordinates of these five centroids, and then the size, which will be a bigger size that we can really see them well in another color and then label.
cues.zh: 要輸入這五個質心的各個座標，再設定更大的尺寸，讓它們清楚可見，並使用另一種顏色，最後加上標籤。

cues.en: All right, let's do this.
cues.zh: 好，開始吧。

cues.en: So here, you can't really guess what is going to be the X coordinate and the Y coordinate.
cues.zh: 這裡的 X 和 Y 座標其實不太可能直接猜出來。

cues.en: So I'm going to tell you right away.
cues.zh: 所以我直接告訴你。

cues.en: You can actually get them thanks to our K-Means object because the K-Means class, as we saw when implementing the elbow method, contains some attributes.
cues.zh: 可以透過 KMeans 物件取得，因為在實作手肘法時看過，KMeans 類別包含一些屬性。

cues.en: We already used one of its attributes, which was the WCSS value.
cues.zh: 已經用過其中一個屬性，也就是 WCSS 值。

cues.en: Remember that was inertia?
cues.zh: 記得是 inertia_ 嗎？

cues.en: And now we're gonna use another attribute from our K-Means object, which is simply cluster centers, right?
cues.zh: 現在要使用 KMeans 物件的另一個屬性，就是 cluster_centers_。

cues.en: And the cluster centers attribute is actually a 2D array in which the rows correspond to the different centroids and the columns correspond to their coordinates.
cues.zh: cluster_centers_ 屬性其實是二維陣列，每一列對應不同的質心，每一欄對應它們的座標。

cues.en: And so here in the scatter function, the coordinates of these centroids will be first K-Means.
cues.zh: 所以在 scatter 函式裡，這些質心的座標先從 kmeans 開始。

cues.en: So here I'm calling K-Means object from which I'm getting this attribute we want, which is, there you go, this one, cluster centers.
cues.zh: 這裡取用 KMeans 物件，再取得需要的屬性，就是這個 cluster_centers_。

cues.en: And since, as we said, it is a 2D array containing in the rows were all the different centroids and in the columns, their coordinates.
cues.zh: 剛才說過，它是二維陣列，每列是不同的質心，每欄是它們的座標。

cues.en: Well for the rows, we're gonna take everything.
cues.zh: 列的部分要全部選取。

cues.en: That's why I'm adding a column here.
cues.zh: 所以我在這裡加上冒號。

cues.en: But for the column here, since we are dealing with the X coordinate, we're just gonna take the first column which has index zero, and which corresponds of course to the X coordinate
cues.zh: 欄的部分，因為正在處理 X 座標，只選第一欄，也就是索引 0，當然對應這些群組中心的 X 座標，

cues.en: of these cluster centers.
cues.zh: 也就是各個質心的 X 座標。

cues.en: Alright, then we're gonna copy this because now we'll have to enter the Y coordinates of these centroids, these cluster centers.
cues.zh: 好，接著複製這裡，因為現在要輸入這些質心，也就是群組中心的 Y 座標。

cues.en: And therefore I'm basing that here and replacing zero here by the index one, which corresponds, of course, to the index of the second column
cues.zh: 貼到這裡，把 0 換成索引 1，當然對應 cluster_centers_ 陣列裡第二欄的索引，

cues.en: inside this cluster center's array and which corresponds, of course, to the Y coordinate of the centroid.
cues.zh: 也就對應質心的 Y 座標。

cues.en: Alright, very simply.
cues.zh: 好，很簡單。

cues.en: So now we have both the X and Y coordinates.
cues.zh: 現在 X 和 Y 座標都有了。

cues.en: And so we're gonna add the rest of the simple stuff, which are first the size.
cues.zh: 接著補上其餘簡單的設定，首先是大小。

cues.en: And here we're gonna choose a larger size like 300 in order to clearly highlight the centroids among all these observation points corresponding to the customers in each cluster.
cues.zh: 這裡選較大的尺寸，例如 300，讓質心能在各群組顧客的觀測點之間清楚凸顯。

cues.en: So s equals 300.
cues.zh: 所以 s 等於 300。

cues.en: And then a color, which we'll choose to be, you know, yellow.
cues.zh: 接著是顏色，就選黃色。

cues.en: We will clearly see them.
cues.zh: 這樣就會看得很清楚。

cues.en: And finally, a label, which we'll choose to be in quotes 'Centroids' and perfect.
cues.zh: 最後是標籤，加上引號寫 'Centroids'，很好。
